decisions.reason: Changing the landing-page book cover size does not alter the mechanics or prize copy.
The book cover had already been separated from required hero integration, and this source changes only the cover's own size and visibility rather than the hero layout.
The source changes a visual book-cover presentation rule and does not revise any hero text or copy-emphasis rule.
The responsive requirement concerns mobile stacking of statistics and mechanics; the source does not establish a mobile-specific cover change.
A landing-page book cover size correction does not change the About page's content.
The source does not alter any Mission page content or presentation requirement.
The book cover's landing-page display size is independent of the product FAQ content.
The source does not change the public prize countdown's label, measure, placement, or behavior.
Changing a visible cover's size does not affect the Mauritius landing-page access restriction.
The source concerns only book-cover presentation and does not change referral commission behavior.
The book cover size correction does not affect Small Block prize rules or execution.
The request to make the landing-page cover smaller is unrelated to the separate optional PDF download link and its presentation.
